svg.title: Combined Account Contribution topography
svg.desc: Combined Account Contribution topography. 01 June 2018 to 01 October 2026. 7,963 contributions from 1,781 listed dates. One continuous chronological landscape, with one crystal per calendar month. Terrain heights are illustrative, not proportional to contribution counts. The artistic silhouette rises in 2022 and 2023, dips slightly in 2024, then climbs consistently from 2025 through the latest displayed month. The headline total and each month's embedded daily records retain the source counts. Months without listed records remain gaps, not confirmed zeroes. The final month is partial when the end date is before month end.
